capabilities: Display notes as cards in masonry or fixed-height grid views
Sort notes by modified time, created time, or filename
Filter notes by folder, tags, and search-bar queries
Save filtered views as Obsidian URI links
Color card backgrounds and sidebars from note tags
disambiguation: Not a file manager; it displays note content as filterable visual cards rather than managing files in a tree.
extras: Released as a Beta version; screenshots referenced in the README were removed from the provided text.
intentEvidence: Initially started as simple fork from the Cards View plugin, now has become a highly functional plugin in itself
motivation: The author built it for personal use and published it after user suggestions, because the Cards View plugin's future development plans would not align with these changes.
problem: Obsidian's default file lists are text-based, making visual browsing and revision of notes across the vault difficult.

relations.evidence: The plugin has been forked initially from this project.
Masonry. Licensed under the MIT License.

summary: Card-based note browser that displays vault notes in masonry or grid views with sorting, search filters, and tag-based colors.
